formulas.name: formulaACHActionSummary
formulas.expression: IF( ISBLANK({!ACH_Status}), null, IF( ISBLANK({!Resume_ACH_Date}), "ACH Status: " + {!ACH_Status} + " - " + TEXT(MONTH({!formulaDateTomorrow}))+"/"+TEXT(DAY({!formulaDateTomorrow}))+"/"+TEXT(YEAR({!formulaDateTomorrow})) + {!formulaLineBreak}, IF( AND( {!ACH_Status}={!StopACH}, NOT(ISBLANK({!Resume_ACH_Date})) ), "ACH Status: " + {!ACH_Status} + " - " + TEXT(MONTH({!formulaDateTomorrow}))+"/"+TEXT(DAY({!formulaDateTomorrow}))+"/"+TEXT(YEAR({!formulaDateTomorrow})) + "; Resume ACH - " +TEXT(MONTH({!Resume_ACH_Date}))+"/"+TEXT(DAY({!Resume_ACH_Date}))+"/"+TEXT(YEAR({!Resume_ACH_Date})) + {!formulaLineBreak}, IF( AND( {!ACH_Status}={!ResumeACH}, NOT(ISBLANK({!Resume_ACH_Date})) ), "ACH Status: " + {!ACH_Status} + " - " + TEXT(MONTH({!Resume_ACH_Date}))+"/"+TEXT(DAY({!Resume_ACH_Date}))+"/"+TEXT(YEAR({!Resume_ACH_Date})) + {!formulaLineBreak}, null ))))

formulas.description: IF ACH Status is Stop, the default value should be tomorrow. If ACH Status is Resume, use the value from the input screen. If ACH Status is null, no value should be inserted.
formulas.name: formulaACHDate
formulas.expression: IF( {!ACH_Status}='Stop ACH', {!formulaDateTomorrow}, IF( AND( {!ACH_Status}='Resume ACH', NOT(ISBLANK({!Resume_ACH_Date})) ), {!Resume_ACH_Date}, IF( AND( {!ACH_Status}='Resume ACH', ISBLANK({!Resume_ACH_Date}) ), {!formulaDateTomorrow}, {!varDateBlank} )))

formulas.description: Inserts the picklist value of Start/Stop ACH if there is a selection on the screen for ACH Status. No value if no selection.
formulas.name: formulaACHStatusActionValue
formulaDateTomorrow
formulas.expression: CASE( MOD( {!$Flow.CurrentDate}- DATE(1900, 1, 7), 7), 0, {!$Flow.CurrentDate}+1, /*if {!$Flow.CurrentDate} is Sun,{!$Flow.CurrentDate}+1=Monday */ 1, {!$Flow.CurrentDate}+1, /*if {!$Flow.CurrentDate} is Mon,{!$Flow.CurrentDate}+1=Tuesday */ 2, {!$Flow.CurrentDate}+1, /*if {!$Flow.CurrentDate} is Tues,{!$Flow.CurrentDate}+1=Wednesday */ 3, {!$Flow.CurrentDate}+1, /*if {!$Flow.CurrentDate} is Wed,{!$Flow.CurrentDate}+1=Thursday*/ 4, {!$Flow.CurrentDate}+1, /*if {!$Flow.CurrentDate} is Thurs,{!$Flow.CurrentDate}+1=Friday */ 5,{!$Flow.CurrentDate}+3, /*if {!$Flow.CurrentDate} is Fri,{!$Flow.CurrentDate}+3=Monday next week */ 6,{!$Flow.CurrentDate}+2, /*if {!$Flow.CurrentDate} is Sat,{!$Flow.CurrentDate}+2=Monday next week */ {!$Flow.CurrentDate})
